contracts.result: Nine ordinary return values; questId is ninth; an optional tenth is controlled by displayQuestID. The existing ProfileHelperFunctionsBase consumer and regression fixture already use the ninth field.
Three flags for a one-based offered-list index. No returned quest ID; cannot replace exact offer identity or ownership.
Five fields per available quest. No returned quest ID; the registered pointer matches the retained original-client decompilation.
Current dialog completion flag plus live player required-item counts. Not a global per-quest completion-history API; inventory and dialog attribution remain necessary.

Reads the negative reward-money field from the selected or indexed quest cache; zero also occurs for missing or invalid cache identity. Candidate diagnostic input only until an independent identity/cache witness exists.
Returns quest text from cache; it is not a Boolean completion observation.

Resolves a special item for a one-based accepted-log index, then returns item link, icon and an item field through 0x707DC0. That third value is not adopted as ordinary inventory count. No guessed raw ABI or automatic use-item recipe is introduced.

mapping_address_note: The current numeric GO mapping constant 10710832 is 0xA36F30, containing plausible table records. Its 0xA38F90 comments are inconsistent; 0xA38F90 contains diagnostic text. No executable address was changed without consumer/ABI proof.

retained_failed_probe.error: The IDA Python evaluation raised NameError for a list-comprehension scope; corrected explicit-loop probe v2 succeeded.

limits: Static original-client analysis establishes these inspected contracts, not live realm SQL, scripted quest recipes, menu ownership, fresh game state or completion.
